name: HashiCorp Consul
author: Netlens
description: Lists what is registered in a Consul service catalog: the nodes become hosts (with their address and whether the agent is alive) and every registered service instance becomes a guest of its node, with its health (passing, warning or critical), tags and port. Netlens ties the nodes and services to the devices it found by address. Read-only: it only sends GET requests.

info.title: Make a read-only ACL token (only when ACLs are on)
info.text: With ACLs enabled, make a policy that can read the catalog and give Netlens a token with it. Without ACLs leave the token empty.

config.label: Consul agents
config.help: One line per Consul datacenter (a server or any agent of it).

columns.label: ACL token
columns.help: Only when ACLs are enabled (sent as X-Consul-Token).

config.label: Hide the 'consul' service
config.help: Every server registers itself as the service 'consul'; it only repeats the node.
